escalations.why: runlog.RunRecord.config is a train.RunConfig, runlog.RunWriter.__init__ takes a train.RunConfig, and runlog.Checkpoint.methods is a Mapping[str, methods.MethodConfig]; so runlog/types.py must import rllab.train and rllab.methods, but the boundaries (CONSTRAINTS.md, import-linter layers in pyproject.toml) allow runlog -> core only and put train and methods in higher layers. lint-imports (CR-24) fails on any version of these types, and a TYPE_CHECKING import counts too. Possible fixes: move RunConfig and MethodConfig (and Settings) into core (core.RunConfig, core.MethodConfig, which train and methods re-export), or move RunRecord, Checkpoint and RunWriter up out of runlog. Also: charts.learning_curve takes baselines.BaselineMeans, but the boundary row says charts -> runlog, evaluate only (the layers contract allows it, the stated rule does not).

Gate can never pass (build-setup bug, not a test): dt claim writes .claude/.check_pkg = 'rllab', so stop_gate.sh and dt land run 'scripts/check.sh gate --pkg rllab', but pkg_scope in scripts/check.sh lists only components (core, worlds, ..., cli), not 'rllab', so check.sh exits 64 'unknown package rllab' before any check runs. That is why M1-T01 solo attempts 2 and 4 were rejected with 'gate failed (rc 64)' whatever the code. Fix (build-setup Revise or dt): for a single package write no .check_pkg (or map 'rllab' to the whole scope in pkg_scope), then re-run M1-T01.
